# E095 -- SuperHi

## Metadata
- **Source:** E095-SuperHi.pdf
- **Category:** Education/Technology
- **Year:** TBD (likely 2018-2020 based on design style)
- **File Size:** 5.5 MB
- **Page Count:** 10
- **Brand / Organization:** SuperHi
- **Industry:** Online creative education / coding courses
- **Guidelines Type:** Brand Guidelines
- **Designer / Agency:** Koto (design agency); contact rik@riklomas.com (Rik Lomas, SuperHi founder)

## Brand Strategy
- Positioning as a creative, exciting digital product for learning code
- "Reactive nature" as a brand concept -- the identity itself is dynamic and multi-state
- People-centric art direction conveying excitement and creativity
- Campaigns like "CODE NOW" connect the brand mission to action

## Logo
- Wordmark "SUPERHi" in uppercase spaced letters with distinctive lowercase "i" featuring an underline beneath it
- Logo has "multiple states" and should be used in variety across platforms to express "the reactive nature of our brand"
- "Hero" state shown: white on electric blue background
- Wave/squiggle icon ("ww" mark) used as a secondary brand element
- Monospace-style letterspacing gives a technical/code-like feel

## Typography
- **Primary typeface:** Custom bespoke display font (available as Illustrator file only, for bespoke executions)
  - Bold geometric uppercase with distinctive custom glyphs (mirrored S, reversed R, emoji-like characters)
  - Informs the logotype style
- **Secondary typeface:** "Betafont" -- a slab-serif with character
  - Available in Thin, Light, and Regular weights
  - Used as header across branded communications and digital executions
  - Available free to download (Dropbox link provided)

## Color
- **Primary:** Electric/royal blue (dominant brand color, used on cover, logo backgrounds, typography panels)
- **Secondary:** Light/sky blue (used in art direction backgrounds)
- **Neutral:** White text on blue, black text on white
- Bold, high-contrast palette -- energetic and digital-native

## Graphics
- Wave/squiggle motif ("ww") used throughout as a consistent graphic device
- "H!" exclamation mark used as a bold graphic element, often oversized and overlaid on photography
- Custom glyph set includes playful special characters (smiley faces, arrows, reversed letters)
- Graphic overlays on photography: large type fragments and brand marks layered over images

## Photography
- People-centric: should convey excitement and creative nature of the digital product
- Diverse subjects shown working, collaborating, and in casual/creative settings
- Photography treated as a backdrop for typographic and graphic overlays
- Note in guidelines: "All photography is placeholder and should not be used beyond these guidelines"

## Applications
- "CODE NOW" campaign materials: poster/flyer series with photography and wave graphic overlays
- Art direction compositions with large "H!" typography over collaborative people photography
- Digital-first applications implied (coding education platform)

## Tone of Voice
- Energetic, creative, approachable
- Technical but not intimidating (coding education context)
- Playful and reactive -- the brand itself is described as having a "reactive nature"

## Outliers
- Very compact guidelines (10 pages) -- more of a brand overview than comprehensive guidelines
- Custom bespoke font only available as Illustrator file, limiting practical usage
- "Betafont" as secondary typeface name suggests it may be a work-in-progress / beta release
- Placeholder photography caveat suggests this may be an early/draft version of the guidelines
- Designed by Koto, a well-known brand agency

## Quality Score
**3 / 5** -- Clean, well-designed guidelines from a reputable agency (Koto) with a strong visual identity. The electric blue palette and multi-state logo concept are distinctive. However, extremely brief at 10 pages with no color specifications, no spacing/clear space rules, no do/don't examples, and placeholder photography. Feels like a summary deck rather than an operational brand guide. The custom font being Illustrator-only limits practical implementation.
